groupings.title: viaSocket: integrations, automations, AI, AI memory, login, plugs
groupings.description: One skill, three jobs. In your product: let users connect any of 2,300+ apps, run actions, react to events, create automations per user, add an AI assistant on any model, AI memory per user, and login with teams and organisations. For yourself: build automations in your own viaSocket workspace. For the platform: build or fix a plug (an app's integration) in the Developer Hub.
